title: basicly output style source
description: An output style authored as <slug>/style.yaml, projected to .claude/output-styles/<slug>.md. An output style rewrites the host's system prompt for every session in the repository, so it is always-on guidance of the same class as a fragment and the catalog owns it rather than a hand-edited markdown file.

schema_version.description: Source-format version; bump only when the loader contract changes.

name.description: The style's display name, as the host lists it. The slug comes from the directory name.

description.description: One line naming what the style changes about the answer.

keep_coding_instructions.description: Projected as `keep-coding-instructions`. False omits the host's built-in software-engineering instructions, including how to verify work, so the default is true.

body.description: The style body in markdown. Every character reaches the system prompt of every session, so it is charged like an always-on fragment.
